sentences.en: Workers are taking a financial beating in the employment crisis.
sentences.zh: 工人们在就业危机中遭受了经济损失。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, full employment can no longer be taken for granted.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，充分就业已不能理所当然地认为是必然的。

sentences.en: I will make an application to that firm for employment.
sentences.zh: 我将向那家公司申请工作。

senses.zh: 雇用, 就业 - 职业, 工作 - 使用, 运用 - 有益的活动
